title: Integrated launch calendar with timebox allocation, service ownership roster, and canary staging matrix
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Define and operationalize a single, machine-readable launch calendar and release-train coordination playbook that aligns timeboxes across runtime, console, and API surfaces. The deliverable will include an ownership roster (service, staging, cutover owner), a canary staging matrix (traffic slices, metrics, rollback gates), and a calendar-as-code template for automated scheduling and guardrails.
background: Over the last six quarters we observed friction during multi-surface launches: overlapping canaries, unclear service ownership during cutovers, and inconsistent canary definitions between runtime and console changes. This initiative standardizes the schedule and decision points, reduces cross-team confusion, and provides a single source of truth for launch readiness and escalation.
goals: Create an authoritative launch calendar-as-code template that can be consumed by the Launch Ops dashboard and Slack bot
Standardize a canary staging matrix with clear metrics and rollback gates for runtime, console, and API changes
Publish a service ownership roster that identifies on-call/cutover owners for each launch lane
Reduce cross-service launch coordination time by 30% and cut Friday rollouts by 80%
success_metrics: Average orchestration meeting time per launch <= 45 minutes
<10% of launches require cross-team hotfixes within 72 hours
90% of launches use the calendar-as-code template
milestones: 2026-03-01: Draft calendar schema and canary matrix (alpha)
2026-03-15: Cross-team review with runtime, console, sdk teams (this ticket target)
2026-04-22: GA rollout and onboarding docs published
rollout_strategy: Phase 1 (alpha): Schema + playbook reviewed by core runtime and console leads
Phase 2 (beta): Pilot on two low-risk launches (internal infra configs and SDK docs)
Phase 3 (GA): Mandate template for all multi-surface launches; provide training and a one-pager
Fallback: If pilot shows 3+ coordination regressions, revert to manual cadence and iterate on matrix
communication_plan: Weekly sync with PM leads from runtime/console/api until GA
Monthly Launch Ops newsletter with calendar highlights and lessons learned
Automated Slack reminders 2 weeks / 3 days / 8 hours before launch windows
Confluence playbook and a short Loom walkthrough linked from the calendar UI
tasks: Draft calendar-as-code JSON schema (owner: ENG infra lead)
Define canary slices and metric gates for runtime (owner: Runtime SRE)
Map service ownership roster and escalation contacts (owner: PM oncall coordinator)
Implement CI job to validate calendar entries against schema (owner: platform eng)
Add calendar import/export to Launch Ops dashboard (owner: Console eng)
Create runbook templates for cutover and rollback (owner: Docs)
Schedule pilot launches and collect feedback (owner: PM)
Postmortem template updated to reference calendar entries (owner: SRE lead)
acceptance_criteria: Calendar-as-code schema reviewed and approved by runtime, console, and api leads
Pilot launches complete with documented runbooks and no major coordination incidents
Launch Ops dashboard imports calendar entries and surfaces owner/rollback gates
Onboarding doc and checklist published and linked from the playbook
risks: Teams do not adopt the calendar template and continue ad-hoc scheduling
Canary gates are misaligned between surfaces leading to false negatives/positives
Automated reminders may create noise and be ignored if schedule spam occurs
Dependencies on ENG-40512 (canary-lab metrics infra) delay pilot
notes: Keep calendar schema intentionally minimal at first (required fields only): owner, window_start, window_end, canary_profile, rollback_gate. We will iterate on richer annotations (regions, capacity hedges) in follow-up tickets.
